_doc: Per-concept settings (no code changes needed). rerank.colour: HSV range (H in degrees 0-360, S and V 0-255) whose pixel fraction per 14 px patch is blended into the re-rank score with rerank.colour_weight; patch_weight scales DINOv2 patch similarity. count_conf: confidence threshold for counting a result as a detected object.

change._doc: Cross-year cell similarity is the primary signal (radiometry differs between NAIP years, so colour then is only supporting evidence). new = colour now >= colour_now_min AND sim <= sim_new_max; existing = sim >= sim_existing_min OR colour then >= colour_then_keep x colour now; else unsure.
